cases.input: Agent A uses immutable C1 with M1 and successor C2 with M2.
cases.expect: Agent A keeps its identity while C1 and C2 remain distinct immutable revisions.

cases.input: T1 is read-only, T2 destructive with human approval and T3 open-world with a narrow audience.
cases.expect: Each call is allowed only by the intersection of grants, scopes, audience and required approvals.

cases.input: A run applies an approved overlay to base configuration C2.
cases.expect: The run pins both C2 digest and the resulting effective configuration digest.

cases.input: Agent A delegates a narrower task to a sub-run within maximum depth.
cases.expect: The chain, exclusions and narrowed scope remain observable.

cases.input: A principal with role=agent invokes a destructive tool without a delegation grant.
cases.expect: The invocation is rejected because the role label grants no authority.

cases.input: A responding endpoint change silently creates a new Agent identity.
cases.expect: The identity change is rejected; endpoint identity remains external.

cases.input: A run rewrites configuration C1 after execution and keeps the same digest.
cases.expect: The rewrite is rejected because configuration revisions are immutable and content-addressed.
